log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Plan: Lead Rotom-Wash to burn physical threats (Mamoswine, Dragonite, Kingambit, Annihilape) and Volt Switch pivot. Gholdengo checks Primarina/Annihilape and can Nasty Plot. Save Mega Dragonite late: Dragon Dance sweep once Ice/Fairy threats weakened, Extreme Speed cleans.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating team matchups and selecting three Pokémon while weighing threats and roles.Adjusting the trio to cover Kingambit and Primarina while accounting for type resistances.

decisions.thought: Lead Mamoswine (Focus Sash + Oblivious) to set Stealth Rock or threaten Garchomp/Dragonite with Ice moves. Bring Dragonite (Lum Berry + Multiscale) as setup sweeper and Kingambit (Black Glasses + Supreme Overlord) as late-game cleaner. Watch out for Rotom-Wash Will-O-Wisp (Dragonite has Lum) and Mimikyu Disguise (Stealth Rock won't break it, use Icicle Crash or Iron Head).

Plan: Lead Rotom-Wash to burn physical threats (Mamoswine, Dragonite, Kingambit, Annihilape) and Volt Switch pivot. Gholdengo checks Primarina/Annihilape and can Nasty Plot. Save Mega Dragonite late: Dragon Dance sweep once Ice/Fairy threats weakened, Extreme Speed cleans. Rotom walls Mamoswine via Levitate; pressure it immediately.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon 3v3 matchup to compare Hydro Pump damage versus Will-o-Wisp safety for Rotom against Mamoswine.Evaluating Hydro Pump OHKO potential and Will-o-Wisp accuracy against likely switch-ins and Focus Sash.

decisions.thought: Lead Mamoswine vs Rotom-Wash. Use Stealth Rock Turn 1 (Focus Sash guarantees survival vs Hydro Pump). Stealth Rock breaks opposing Dragonite's Multiscale and chips switches. Keep Dragonite (Lum Berry + Multiscale) healthy to set up Dragon Dance vs Rotom-Wash later, and save Kingambit as late-game Supreme Overlord cleaner.

Rotom walls Mamoswine via Levitate; Hydro Pump missed T1, repeat to pressure before it attacks freely. Burn later if it stays physical threat. Save Gholdengo for Primarina/Annihilape, Mega Dragonite late after Ice/Fairy weakened. Rocks hurt Dragonite switch-ins.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Hydro Pump versus Will-O-Wisp against Mamoswine while weighing damage output and switch risk.

decisions.thought: Stealth Rock is up and Mamoswine still has Focus Sash intact (100% HP). Mamoswine (145 Spe) outsped Rotom-Wash on Turn 1. Rotom-Wash has Levitate (immune to Earthquake) and Hydro Pump. Spam Icicle Crash to chip/flinch Rotom-Wash until Mamoswine goes down, then bring in Dragonite (Lum Berry + Multiscale) to set up Dragon Dance and sweep with Kingambit in back.

Mamoswine outspeeds Rotom (moved first both turns), Focus Sash broken at 1%. Risk: Endeavor+Ice Shard, but Sitrus may save Rotom; switching would expose Gholdengo/Dragonite (rocks break Multiscale). Kill Mamoswine now. Save Gholdengo for Primarina/Annihilape, Mega Dragonite late.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Mamoswine's remaining HP and Focus Sash state to evaluate Volt Switch versus Hydro Pump risks and switch predictions.Evaluating Endeavor and Ice Shard speed and damage risks against staying versus switching.

decisions.thought: Stealth Rock is up. Mamoswine (145 Spe) outspeeds Rotom-Wash (no Leftovers shown, 83% HP, has Hydro Pump). Click Icicle Crash again to chip/flinch Rotom-Wash before Mamoswine faints (saving Supreme Overlord stack). Once Mamoswine faints, bring in Dragonite (Lum Berry + Multiscale) to set up Dragon Dance vs Rotom-Wash, and save Kingambit as late-game cleaner.

Stealth Rock is up. Mamoswine fainted (1 Supreme Overlord stack). Rotom-Wash is at 64% HP (slower than 145 Spe, used Hydro Pump 3x, possibly Choice Specs or Sitrus/Chesto). Bring in Dragonite (Multiscale + Lum Berry) to set up Dragon Dance on Rotom-Wash, absorbing Will-O-Wisp/Thunder Wave with Lum Berry. Save Kingambit as late-game cleaner.

Mamoswine (Sash, Stealth Rock, Icicle Crash) fainted; rocks on our side hurt Dragonite/Multiscale. Rotom 64% vs fresh opposing Dragonite. Burn it to cripple Dragon Dance/physical attacks before pivoting. Save Gholdengo for last unknown (Primarina/Annihilape/Kingambit/Gholdengo), Mega Dragonite late-game.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Rotom versus Dragonite matchup and weighing Will-O-Wisp burn utility against Volt Switch for breaking Multiscale.

decisions.thought: Stealth Rock is up. Mamoswine fainted (1 Supreme Overlord stack). Rotom-Wash (64% HP, <145 Spe) used Hydro Pump 3x. Use Dragon Dance with Dragonite (Multiscale + Lum Berry cures Will-O-Wisp/Thunder Wave). Avoid Outrage if Mimikyu is unseen; use Extreme Speed to chip/KO Rotom-Wash or DD again if Lum is intact. Save Kingambit to clean late-game.

Opp Dragonite +1 Atk/Spe, likely Multiscale intact; Rotom missed burn. Our Dragonite switching in loses Multiscale to rocks and is outsped, Gholdengo risks Earthquake. Stay with bulky Rotom, burn to cripple setup, then Pain Split/Volt Switch. Third opp unknown: save Gholdengo, Mega Dragonite late.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokemon battle damage and move options to compare burning versus Volt Switching against Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Stealth Rock is up. Mamoswine fainted (1 Supreme Overlord stack). Rotom-Wash (64% HP, <145 Spe) missed Will-O-Wisp on Turn 4. Dragonite still has Multiscale and Lum Berry intact at +1/+1. Use Dragon Dance again to reach +2/+2 while Lum Berry absorbs Will-O-Wisp, then KO Rotom-Wash with Extreme Speed without locking into Outrage before seeing if Mimikyu is in the back.

Opp Dragonite +2/+2, Lum cured burn, Multiscale likely intact. Rotom 64%; switching loses our Dragonite's Multiscale to rocks and Gholdengo risks +2 Earthquake. Stay in: burn halves its attack, Levitate dodges Earthquake. If Rotom falls, use Dragonite Extreme Speed to chip/break Multiscale, save Gholdengo for last unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Pokemon battle damage calculations and switch options against a boosted Dragonite.Assessing burn chance and damage ranges to justify Will-O-Wisp and the follow-up switch order.

decisions.thought: Stealth Rock is up. Mamoswine fainted (1 Supreme Overlord stack). Rotom-Wash (64% HP, physically bulky, used Hydro Pump and Will-O-Wisp). Dragonite is at +2/+2, 100% HP (Multiscale active), Lum Berry consumed. Use Extreme Speed to KO or heavily damage Rotom-Wash before it uses Will-O-Wisp again, avoiding Outrage lock in case Mimikyu is in the back. Kingambit cleans late-game.

Opp Dragonite +2/+2 but now burned and Multiscale broken by burn chip. Rotom 60 HP should survive burned Extreme Speed; Pain Split then steals huge HP and cuts Dragonite to ~half. If Rotom falls, Gholdengo resists Dragon, is immune to Extreme Speed, and finishes it; save Mega Dragonite for last unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokemon damage calculations and burn mechanics to evaluate Rotom's survival and Pain Split outcome.Evaluating alternative moves and entry options against the burned Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Stealth Rock is up. Mamoswine fainted. Dragonite is burned at +2/+2 (94% HP). Rotom-Wash is at 38% (Sitrus consumed, used Hydro Pump and Will-O-Wisp). Burned +2 Extreme Speed deals ~25% to Rotom-Wash (won't KO), while burned +2 Dragon Dance brings Dragonite to +3/+3 so Extreme Speed or Outrage can do more damage next turn. Kingambit cleans late-game.

Opp Dragonite +3/+3, burned, Multiscale broken, 58%. Rotom 109 HP survives a burned hit; Volt Switch chips it, then Gholdengo (immune Extreme Speed, resists Dragon Claw) finishes with Make It Rain. Save Mega Dragonite for unknown third: Gholdengo, Kingambit, Primarina, or Annihilape.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon battle state and damage calculations to evaluate next move options.Evaluating damage ranges and type matchups to compare Rotom and Gholdengo move choices.

decisions.thought: Stealth Rock is up. Mamoswine fainted. Rotom-Wash (69% HP, Sitrus consumed) used Hydro Pump, Will-O-Wisp, Pain Split. Dragonite is burned at +3/+3 (58.9% HP). At +2 unburned, Extreme Speed did 51%; burned +3 Outrage has 2.8125x the power of +2 Extreme Speed (~71% damage), enough to KO Rotom-Wash now before another Pain Split. Kingambit cleans late-game with 2 Overlord stacks.

Opp Dragonite +3/+3 burned, 52%, Multiscale broken, moves DD/Extreme Speed/Outrage, likely Earthquake. Gholdengo resists Outrage, immune to Extreme Speed, survives burned EQ and KOs with Make It Rain. Save Mega Dragonite (rocks would break Multiscale) for unknown third.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Gholdengo switch viability against Dragonite by weighing resistances against Earthquake damage risk at calculated net attack multiplier.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Opp Dragonite +3/+3 burned, 52%, Multiscale broken, likely locked into Outrage after Turn 8. Gholdengo resists Outrage, immune to Extreme Speed, and Make It Rain should KO from 52%. Save Dragonite (Mega, rocks break Multiscale) for unknown third: Gholdengo/Kingambit/Primarina/Annihilape.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Pokemon damage math for Gholdengo vs burned +3 Dragonite Earthquake to check if it survives.Comparing Outrage and Make It Rain damage to confirm Gholdengo survives and can KO Dragonite.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Kingambit is opponent's last Pokémon, Supreme Overlord boosted. Gholdengo at -2 likely dies to Kowtow/Sucker Punch, so chip with Make It Rain first. Then Dragonite enters after rocks, Mega Dragon Dances (Sucker Punch fails vs status), then boosted Earthquake should KO Kingambit.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Gholdengo vs Kingambit damage and matchup to recommend a switch to Dragonite.Calculating damage ranges and priority interactions to compare Recover stalling versus switching to Dragonite.Evaluating type matchups and sequencing to weigh switching to Dragonite against keeping Gholdengo as a sacrifice.

decisions.thought: Stealth Rock is up. Rotom-Wash fainted. Gholdengo is at 51% HP, -2 SpA, Leftovers. Kingambit is at 100% HP with 2 Overlord stacks and Black Glasses. At -2 SpA, even Focus Blast cannot OHKO Kingambit, while Kowtow Cleave easily OHKOs Gholdengo (or chunks a switch-in) and beats Recover/Nasty Plot/switch, unlike Sucker Punch. Save Swords Dance/Sucker Punch for the final Pokemon.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Kingambit is last, 84%, Supreme Overlord x2. Gholdengo chip done. Mega Dragon Dance: Sucker Punch fails vs status, Mega bulk helps survive Kowtow/Iron Head. Then +1 Mega Earthquake should KO. Don't attack directly into Sucker Punch unboosted.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage calculations and move priority for Dragonite versus Kingambit to decide between Mega and Earthquake.

decisions.thought: Final 1v1: Kingambit (174/207 HP, Black Glasses, 2 Overlord stacks) vs Dragonite (75% HP, Stealth Rock broken Multiscale). Unboosted Dragonite's Earthquake (~55%) or Fire Punch (~45%) cannot OHKO Kingambit. Kowtow Cleave deals ~70-85% to 0 Def Dragonite, either OHKOing at 75% HP or putting it into Sucker Punch range next turn, and doesn't lose to Dragon Dance/Roost/Extreme Speed.

Kingambit last, 84%, Supreme Overlord x2, only Kowtow revealed. Mega Dragonite at 9 HP, +1/+1, outspeeds. +1 Earthquake is the KO play; second Dragon Dance only wins if it has and uses Sucker Punch, but it used Kowtow into last Dance, suggesting no Sucker or no prediction.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Pokemon battle turn options and move priority to avoid a KO.Assessing Sucker Punch likelihood versus Kowtow to choose between attacking and setting up.Evaluating opponent move patterns and bot behavior to weigh EQ against a second Dragon Dance.

decisions.thought: Final 1v1: Kingambit (174/207 HP) vs Mega Dragonite (5% HP, +1 Atk/+1 Spe). +1 Mega Dragonite's Earthquake (~75% max) cannot OHKO Kingambit from 84.1% HP (unless Low Kick/Superpower). If we click Kowtow Cleave, we beat Roost, Dragon Dance, Extreme Speed, and survive Earthquake/Fire Punch to KO. However, Sucker Punch outspeeds Earthquake/Low Kick/Fire Punch directly for the immediate KO if they attack. Wait: Kowtow Cleave did 70% last turn; if they Roost (to 55%), Kowtow Cleave still KOs, whereas Sucker Punch fails against Roost/DD/Extreme Speed. Let's check if +1 Earthquake KOs: 193 Atk +1 EQ vs 207 HP / 140 Def = ~150-178 dmg (can high-roll OHKO!). So Sucker Punch is safer against attacks.
